title: Getting kb's search to 80%: context in every chunk, better fusion, then a small reranker
description: Where kb's search stands on this project's docs (hit@1 0.63–0.67, hit@3 0.77), what our own experiments showed (heading-path context + re-blending reaches 0.73 / 0.80), and what research across GitHub, Sourcegraph, aider, Continue, Sweep, bloop and 100+ papers, blogs and model cards says it takes to reach 80%, with a staged plan for E-7.
